Welcome to your luxurious beach retreat! This stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom vacation home promises the ultimate escape with unparalleled relaxation. Step inside to discover a spacious and elegantly furnished interior, perfect for gatherings of friends and family. Outside, soak up the sun by the sparkling pool or enjoy a soothing soak in the hot tub. Book now and indulge in the ultimate beachfront experience at our exquisite oasis 🌴🌊🌞!

✨ PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS ✨

Happy Hut features three opulent king-size and one queen sized bedrooms, accompanied by a private en-suite bathroom. Each en-suite is a sanctuary itself, boasting luxurious fixtures, elegant tile work, and spacious showers and/or soaking tubs.

The heart of the home is a gourmet kitchen, fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, and ample counter space, ideal for preparing gourmet meals or casual snacks. Share meals in the grand dining area or take advantage of the outdoor dining space featuring an outdoor kitchen and fireplace.

Relaxation awaits in the expansive living area, with four glass doors provide breathtaking views of your private outdoor oasis! Unwind with a movie night inside or gather around the large kitchen island sipping your favorite drink.

Indulge in the ultimate outdoor relaxation with our heated pool featuring a beaching shelf to take in the Florida sun or enjoy a leisurely swim with family and friends. Adjacent to the pool, our hot tub beckons with its soothing jets, perfect for a calming soak under the stars. Immerse yourself in warmth and tranquility as you melt away stress and tension, enveloped by the peaceful ambiance of the beachfront setting.

When it’s time to eat, enjoy the outdoor kitchen, where culinary delights meet the beauty of the beach. Equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a built-in grill, mini refrigerator, and ample counter space, it`s perfect for creating delicious meals al fresco. Prepare fresh seafood caught just off the coast or grill up savory steaks while
soaking in the salty breeze. For added convenience, a sink and prep area ensure effortless meal preparation and cleanup.

Dine in style at the adjacent dining area, complete with a spacious table and comfortable seating for enjoying meals or gather around the outdoor fire place to watch a movie.

First Floor
★ Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with en-suite
★ Large living room
★ Full Kitchen: Double sided-refrigerator, Two pull out freezers, Dishwasher, Microwave, fully stocked kitchen for cooking meals and serving meals, and a Keruig/Drip Coffee Combo Maker
★ Dining Room: Large dining table that seats 10
★ 2-piece bathroom

Outdoor Spaces
★ The fully fenced backyard features a covered patio with ample seating for all, heated pool plus spa, outdoor kitchen, large flat screen, and outdoor fireplace
★ Golf cart garage

★ Covered front porch with seating
★ Front porch with seating

SPECIAL NOTE: This property has a pool and hot tub. Please bring appropriate life vests for guests who cannot swim. Always be vigilant with young children around the pool area and never leave guests who cannot swim unattended. Swimming is at your own risk.

*The pool temperature will be between 78-88 degrees when heated and the spa temperature will be 100-102 degrees*
*The pool and spa are heated March 1 - October 31st. This service is included in your rate.*
*The pool and spa are not heated November 1st - February 28th. The pool and spa can be heated for a $50 daily rate during this time. You must request and pay for this service.*

You will receive a digital code to access the front door lock to the home a day prior to your arrival.

I plan to interact with the guests to ensure they have a five star stay!

Our home is in Inlet Beach. You are a 1–2-minute drive away from the beautiful beaches of the Emerald Coast.

Inlet Beach, a hidden gem along the Emerald Coast renowned for its pristine white sands, turquoise waters, and relaxed atmosphere. Nestled between Panama City Beach and Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach offers a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience, making it an ideal destination for your beach getaway.

The crystal-clear waters are perfect for swimming, paddle boarding, or snorkeling, providing endless opportunities for aquatic adventures. Watch dolphins play offshore or try your hand at fishing in the surf for a taste of local coastal life.

*Parking for 4-5 vehicles depending on size*
*The property comes with 6 beach chairs, 2 beach wagons, and 1 umbrella for your enjoyment*
*The property offers beach towels for use during your stay*

Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
